subject: Bad Jokes + Europe's largest Brand
body:
Hello to the team at {{companyName}},

I imagine your inbox is about as full as a regular chocolate bar is of sugar. Sadly, we can only fix one of those.

I hope that bad joke buys me another email :)

Bad jokes aside, as mentioned, we are Diablo Sugar Free, Europe's largest sugar-free confectionery company, with 117 snacks across 11 categories, from cakes and biscuits to wafers and spreads, all sweetened without aspartame. Our catalogue: {{catalogue_link_text}}

We supply more than 126 countries and are listed with Carrefour, Tesco, Lidl and Holland & Barrett, etc, but do not yet have a direct partner in {{market_country}}.

If this is better suited to a colleague, could you kindly pass it on to the person responsible for purchasing or new brands?

I'd love to set up a call with your team and our Strategy Director to look at what the range would need to earn properly for your professional customers.

Would this week work, or would next week suit better?

Book a quick meeting with us: {{booking_link_text}}

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
International Account Executive
Diablo Sugar Free


We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.
